patch.value: Execute bounded recursive collection, training, evaluation and promotion

Implement the full execution loop specified in RECURSIVE_TRAINING.md. Existing pm-rl-yi7j supplies lineage and promotion gates; it does not execute training. Add a TypeScript/Rust controller with local Docker Compose trainer adapters, content-addressed checkpoints, atomic budget reservations, idempotent resumption, cancellation and held-out evaluation. Companion pm-cli-website-eag2 and pm-cli-website-hktr.

Two real training generations produce changed checkpoints and collect with the promoted successor; a bounded LLM adapter demonstrates parameter updates; two controllers launch a job once; crash and cancellation drills preserve artifacts and budget integrity; contamination and invalid checkpoints stop promotion; every authored source passes exact four-metric coverage and documented-surface gates

value.author: codex-pm-native
value.text: Execution foundation is implemented under child pm-rl-s44k: a real bounded TypeScript contextual-bandit policy-gradient adapter supplies promoted checkpoints to successor collection. RECURSIVE_TRAINING.md distinguishes this numerical adapter from the remaining SDK-persisted job controller, atomic approved-budget reservations, owner leases, crash/cancellation recovery, Compose isolation and LLM parameter-update acceptance. The epic remains open. Repeated evaluation is adaptive validation, so a separate final benchmark is still required.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
Promotion gate design (closing the recursive self-improvement loop):

PROPERTY: A candidate policy is promoted ONLY when its held-out expected reward exceeds the incumbent's by at least the effect threshold, with confidence >= 1-alpha, using at least minSamples evaluation episodes, AND the held-out evaluation set is not reachable from the candidate's training data. The default answer is NO: absent, unreadable, self-referential, incomparable, or statistically insufficient evidence promotes NOTHING.

DOMAIN: Pairs of bounded-reward evaluation evidence records (candidate + incumbent) carrying a finite empirical mean, a finite sample count, and declared reward bounds [lo, hi]; a confidence level in (0,1), a minimum sample count >= 1, an effect threshold >= 0; and a contamination verdict (null = isolated).

STATISTICAL CRITERION: Hoeffding inequality for bounded random variables. Distribution-free, valid for any bounded objective a caller pins a range to, conservative for small samples (the property a fail-closed gate wants). epsilon = (hi - lo) * sqrt(ln(2/alpha)/(2n)). Promote iff candidate lower confidence bound exceeds incumbent upper confidence bound by the effect threshold (maximize; inverted for minimize). Chosen over a distribution-assuming bound because RL reward distributions are unknown and a single lucky sample must not promote; Hoeffding needs no distribution assumption and is loosest exactly when samples are few.

WHAT IT BUYS: with probability >= 1-alpha, a promoted candidate's TRUE expected reward exceeds the incumbent's by at least the effect threshold. A single lucky sample, a regression, a contaminated held-out set, and a sub-threshold improvement are all refused.

WHAT IT DOES NOT BUY: protection against a held-out set semantically duplicated under a different name (the contamination gate's job, consumed not rebuilt); non-stationary environments; unbiased estimates after repeated selection (adaptive validation, not a final benchmark); reward hacking on the held-out set itself.

HELD-OUT ISOLATION IS STRUCTURAL: the bandit adapter validates training and evaluation example identities disjoint before any gradient, so the held-out set is unreachable from the training loop by construction; the gate's contamination verdict is null. The persisted promoteGeneration flow already enforces the same via findContaminationPath over provenance edges.

LINEAGE: every promotion and every refusal is recorded. In the recursive loop (bandit adapter) each generation receipt carries promoted + refusalReason + the sampled held-out means; the generations array is the auditable chain from generation 0 to N. Transitive invalidation uses the existing buildLineageAncestry forward propagation and invalidate.ts (not rebuilt).

REMAINING ON THIS EPIC: the durable execution controller (Docker Compose trainer, atomic budget reservations, owner leases, crash/cancellation recovery, LLM parameter-update acceptance) and wiring the statistical gate into the persisted rl generation promote command's scores contract remain separate slices. This delivery closes the recursive self-improvement loop's promotion decision; it does not deliver the full durable controller.

value.note: promotion with NO candidate evaluation evidence is refused (fail-closed default is no)

a regressing generation is refused by the gate and the refusal reason is recorded as lineage; a single lucky held-out sample cannot promote below the gate minimum sample count; the gate refusal is attributable
